why: In July 2026 an AI-generated, sorry-free Lean 'disproof' of the Collatz conjecture (Ramana Kumar, July 25) passed two independent checkers by exploiting Lean kernel soundness bugs; it was shown false and retracted within days (kernel bug fixed July 28). Numerous other 2025-2026 proof preprints (e.g. arXiv:2309.09991, arXiv:2502.20642) remain unverified/uncredible and computational verification was extended to 2^71, but the withdrawn AI-generated disproof claim is itself a countable event per the withdrawn-claim rule.
